disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep original expiry; await new intake after expiry instead of silently extending permission.

new_weaknesses.statement: Late contradictory data can overwrite newer intake.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Replay-derived high-water mark; reject and retain older intake.

new_weaknesses.statement: An observation ID can cross event variants or disguise changed facts.

new_weaknesses.statement: Transport recovery may surface a question after its deadline.
